factual_claims.source_evidence: Operations section: 'The market has developed weakly during the year due to macroeconomic and geopolitical conditions. JLT's run-rate business have decreased during the year in the warehouse/logistics, transportation and manufacturing segments'

factual_claims.claim: Demand was more positive in ports and mining, supporting the company's strategy of broadening its market exposure.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO letter: 'At the same time, demand in our largest market segment, warehousing and logistics, remained subdued... We are addressing this weakness by increasing focus in other segments, especially ports as well as construction and mining equipment – areas where we are now starting to see results'

factual_claims.claim: JLT launched the JLT6015, described as the industry’s first rugged vehicle-mounted computer with a 15-inch Full HD display, and introduced an AI- and machine-learning-based screen-blanking safety solution.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Product development section: 'During the year, JLT expanded its product offering through the launch of the JLT6015, the industry’s first vehicle-mounted computer featuring a Full HD 15-inch display... We also launched an innovative 'screen blanking' solution that leverages the unique sensors in our computers and uses AI and machine learning'

factual_claims.claim: The company also validated its VERSO computers for port operations with Navis.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO letter: 'Our VERSO computers were validated for port operations by Navis, a leading supplier of port operating systems'

factual_claims.claim: Cash flow was reported at positive SEK 3.7 million, while cash and cash equivalents increased to SEK 16.9 million from SEK 13.3 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement: 'CASH FLOW FROM OPERATING ACTIVITIES 5,878 7,506'... Closing cash and cash equivalents 16,934 13,251'

factual_claims.claim: Inventory reduction was a key factor, with inventories falling by SEK 12.7 million to SEK 25.5 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report: 'The efforts to reduce the safety stock that was built up during the component shortage have resulted in inventory decreasing by MSEK 12.7 during the year'... Current assets section shows inventories at MSEK 25.5 (38.258)

factual_claims.claim: Equity declined to SEK 41.8 million from SEK 47.6 million, while solidity improved to 59% from 54%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Equity section: 'Equity amounted to MSEK 41.8 (47.6)... The solidity was 59 percent (54)'

factual_claims.claim: No dividend is proposed for 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Share section: 'The Board of Directors proposes to the Annual General Meeting that no dividend (SEK 0.00) be paid for the fiscal year 2025'

factual_claims.claim: Overall, JLT delivered stronger commercial performance and substantially reduced its losses, but currency pressure, weak core-market demand and negative operating margins continued to weigh on results.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO summary and financial results confirm this assessment: 'Despite geopolitical uncertainty, weak demand in our largest segment and significant currency effects, JLT performed stably and better than the industry as a whole... This year’s result is thus not only a recovery, but also an acknowledgment that our long-term priorities create sustainable value'
